gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-almendra: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz stamps out big-bodied lowercase letters before Almendra settles in beneath it. The serif's deep lowercase midsection gives that loud top somewhere to land.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-port-lligat: Capture Smallz leads with raw, tactical energy in its big-bodied lowercase letters. But Port Lligat Slab hugs its letter shapes, with porthole-wide counters and curve ends left open to breathe.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-outfit: Outfit is a friendly sans whose curves stop short of closing. Capture Smallz does its best work with big-bodied, raw lowercase letters, while Outfit stays clean, drawn with one-tip simplicity in every glyph.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-sora: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz piles up big-bodied lowercase that stands tall against the baseline. Sora's round bowls never swell or thin, and that precision anchors the whole pairing.
gen-dafont-college-gf-almendra: College gives every curve the full weight of a straight stem, with big counters in a tall lowercase. The best part is Almendra's bookish, deep-bellied dignity under College's drive.
gen-dafont-college-gf-bree-serif: College runs with no modulation in the stroke, so its dynamic, authoritative lowercase stands tall with big counters. College grabs attention while Bree Serif, outsized in lowercase, does the literary talking.
gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-spline-sans: Wide-mouthed and tall-bodied, Conthrax stretches its lowercase until capitals barely rise above it, while Spline Sans stays contemporary and approachable. Conthrax earns its keep when it is big and brief.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-bree-serif: Bree Serif reads literary and refined, its outsized lowercase proportions filling each line, while Conthrax stays geometric up top. Long paragraphs would unspool smoothly, like following a single thread.
gen-dafont-conthrax-sora: Precise from the first glance, Sora keeps its curves free of swell beneath the geometric, wide-mouthed Conthrax. Paragraphs would move steadily, with widely parted letters keeping every line clear.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-almendra-sc: Almendra SC keeps its letter mouths open and dignified, a fitting partner for the widely spaced, laser-etched lines of Cowboys. Neon-tube thickness meets serif authority, and neither one crowds the other.
